name: computer-use-intel
description: MCP server mimicking OpenAI Codex 'Computer Use' on Intel Macs (x86_64)

scripts.build: tsc && npm run build:ocr && npm run build:ax && npm run build:cg
scripts.build:ocr: xcrun swiftc -O -o dist/vision-ocr src/vision-ocr.swift -framework Vision -framework AppKit || (echo '[build:ocr] swiftc failed - falling back to PyObjC OCR' && npm run build:ocr:py)
scripts.build:ax: xcrun swiftc -O -o dist/ax-helper src/ax-helper.swift -framework AppKit -framework ApplicationServices || echo '[build:ax] swiftc failed - Accessibility tools (get_ui_elements, click_element, menus, windows) will be unavailable'
scripts.build:cg: xcrun swiftc -O -o dist/cgevent src/cgevent.swift -framework CoreGraphics -framework AppKit || echo '[build:cg] swiftc failed - precise scroll + arbitrary key hold/tap (key_tap) will be unavailable'
